# AudioClipInput

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Speech.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Speech.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Speech/AudioClipInput.cs#L11)

Feeds the recogniser from a playing [`AudioSource`](https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/AudioSource.html) instead of a microphone, so a
scene's spoken steps can be exercised at a desk with a recording of the right sentence.
Reads whatever the source has played since the last frame, which is why the source has to be
playing for anything to be recognised.

```csharp
[RequireComponent(typeof(AudioSource))]
public class AudioClipInput : SpeechAudioInput
```

## Properties

### IsCapturing {#iscapturing}

Whether audio is arriving right now. The manager holds the recogniser idle while this is
false, so silence from a stopped microphone is never mistaken for silence from a quiet room.
